name: Witch Doctor: Bwonsamdi's Edge raises Spirit Eclipse's explosion damage (#1363)
contract: Regression for #1363: Bwonsamdi's Edge (712435) carries ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), classmask word1 bit 3 (8), matching exactly the SpellFamilyFlags[1]=8 of Spirit Eclipse Explosion (802712, SpellFamilyName 19). EffectBasePoints[0]=39 -> real 40%. Values confirmed identical against both the client DBC extraction and the deployed slot-3 worldserver's own DataDir/dbc/Spell.dbc (byte-for-byte for every field used here). REPAIR NOTE (2026-09-22): live runs against the deployed binary show the aura DOES apply after learn (metric aura=1, aura_amount effect0=40, confirmed with within_ms polling up to 3000ms so this is not a one-tick timing artifact) but Player::ApplySpellMod never reflects the +40% on 802712 under ANY SpellModOp (scanned ops 0-12, all read back unmodified 1000) - i.e. Player::AddSpellMod is provably never invoked for this aura effect, even though GetAmount() is correctly computed. The identical generic mechanism (AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod / AuraEffect::HandleEffect / SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod) is proven working in this exact binary by the sibling scenario witchdoctor-nuke-damage-cast-speed-spellmods.json (#2000, It's Da Voodoo 560278 -> ShadowflareHit 802704, also family 19, op 0, learn+within_ms pattern, PASSES). Static tracing of every branch in that call chain found no logical path that would reject/skip 712435->802712 given the confirmed DBC data, so the root cause was not isolated within the 3-run budget for this repair pass; this is recorded as a real, reproducible native-behavior gap for #1363, not a scenario defect. See .agents/plans/audit-witchdoctor/repair-witchdoctor-bwonsamdis-edge-eclipse-splash.md for full run evidence.

steps.label: No damage bonus on Spirit Eclipse Explosion before Bwonsamdi's Edge
Bwonsamdi's Edge aura applies after learn
Bwonsamdi's Edge adds 40% damage to Spirit Eclipse Explosion
Damage bonus reverts once Bwonsamdi's Edge is unlearned
